about: Hebrew APA 7 examples transcribed from the published university library guides (plan W11.H15), each with its source. Transcription: Bar-Ilan's page was read through a summarising fetch tool and Haifa's PDF through text extraction (which prints parentheses reversed, ')2009(' — written here the right way round); entries that came through truncated were left out. Owed: check each entry against the guide by eye, and add entries up to 40 from the full guides (W11.H15 acceptance: >= 38/40 identical).
normalisation: Compared after: FSI/PDI removed; italics markers removed (Haifa's PDF text has no italics); the initial mark unified (׳, ' and . after a single Hebrew letter are the same mark — Bar-Ilan writes א', Haifa writes א., Lumen writes א׳); typographic apostrophe/geresh in surnames unified.

examples.note: The guide writes a period after the last author before the year here ('ד'. (2020)') but not in its one-author example ('א' (2017)'): the guide is not consistent with itself.
